items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: And that was when Red was playing the piano. And I was playing the violin. ... we ended up, just about three of us, playing the rest of the band.

ctx.x: Was that band playing what you would call jazz as opposed to what you used to hear and you used to hear?

It was New Orleans jazz, but it wasn't loud music. Pierron was a violinist and he had guitar playing, they had Sweet Ammo playing the piano and two or three others in there. I don't think they had any brass instruments in there. They probably had a couple of saxophones or something like that. But it was pretty music. I mean, he was well known. They had wonderful timing. Everybody used to love to go out there to dance. And when they went out there, they danced. It was just a place that people would go to. It had a…
Dad played out the West End Roof for a while, but it wasn't much longer than that he quit.
